articles.headline: Russia to extend diesel export ban and quotas
articles.brief: Russia is set to extend its diesel export ban and implement quotas to fulfill a US deal, according to industry sources closely tracking the energy trade negotiations.

articles.headline: Dockworkers at 100 ports to strike against arms shipments
articles.brief: Dockworkers across more than one hundred ports are preparing to stage a major strike protesting international arms shipments, threatening global supply chain disruptions.

articles.headline: GM to pay 220 million over driver privacy violations
articles.brief: General Motors has agreed to pay a 220 million dollar settlement to resolve allegations that the automaker violated drivers' privacy rights without proper consent.

articles.headline: Binance potential hack triggers 3 billion crypto freeze
articles.brief: A potential security breach at cryptocurrency exchange Binance has prompted authorities and platforms to freeze roughly 3 billion dollars in digital assets.

articles.headline: ECB signals December hike despite yield rise pressures
articles.brief: The European Central Bank has signaled a potential rate hike in December, even as rising bond yields threaten to weigh on broader economic growth.

articles.headline: Russian drone strike kills 14 on Ukrainian rail platform
articles.brief: A devastating Russian drone strike has killed 14 people on a Ukrainian railway platform, while separate attacks across the region claimed six additional lives.

articles.headline: Bhutan glacial flood triggers India evacuation alert
articles.brief: A glacial lake outburst flood in Bhutan has forced state authorities in West Bengal and Assam to issue high alerts and order evacuations along the Sankosh River.

articles.headline: Netanyahu party claims Israel election results stolen
articles.brief: Members of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's party are alleging voter fraud after preliminary election results showed the incumbent coalition losing its parliamentary majority.

articles.headline: China promotes military purge enforcer to Politburo
articles.brief: China's ruling Communist Party has elevated General Zhang Shengmin, the key enforcer behind sweeping military anti-corruption purges, to a prominent position on the Politburo.

articles.headline: Supreme Court says corporate ministry hijacked NCLT
articles.brief: The Supreme Court of India has sharply criticized the corporate affairs ministry, declaring that the National Company Law Tribunal and Appellate Tribunal have been effectively hijacked.

articles.headline: Woman dies after changing medication on ChatGPT advice
articles.brief: A wrongful death lawsuit reveals a woman passed away after reducing her anti-seizure medication based on guidance provided by the AI chatbot ChatGPT, renewing safety debates.

articles.headline: Three killed in mid-air helicopter collision in Oregon
articles.brief: Three people have been confirmed dead following a tragic mid-air collision involving two helicopters near an airport in the US state of Oregon.

articles.headline: Rohit Sharma viewed as crucial glue for Mumbai Indians
articles.brief: Amid major structural overhauls and coaching staff changes for Mumbai Indians, bringing Rohit Sharma back into a leadership capacity could offer vital stability for the team.

articles.headline: Agencies shipped billions in military gear to Iran
articles.brief: Investigations reveal that thousands of foreign agencies successfully circumvented past blockades to ship over two billion dollars in military equipment to Iran.

articles.headline: Soaring technology costs push shoppers toward EMIs
articles.brief: Surging prices for consumer electronics and gadgets are driving festive shoppers across India to increasingly rely on equated monthly installment plans to afford purchases.

articles.headline: IPL 2027 transition period focuses on sustainable team management
articles.brief: Franchises across the Indian Premier League are reshaping their long-term strategies, prioritizing multi-year talent cultivation and robust coaching continuity over immediate results.
